findings.finding: Empty detach leaves the source circular and prevents immediate source reuse.
Rust and negative-trait vectors use look-alike structs; the C vector is independent and none execute or compare the production helper.
Destination validation accepts mixed null/self vacant link states.
Unsafe caller, callback and retained-lifetime obligations plus transaction/source identity are undocumented or absent.

accepted_observations: The primitive is additive/private and the production finish path matches the base commit.
Nonempty transfer repairs boundary links without changing page metadata.
Drain validates the retained ring before release, conditional on exclusive stable ownership.
No implicit freeing destructor was added.
